_doc: Codex CLI settings. Points at the shared hooks/hooks.json (same as Claude Code) so install.sh can rewrite both runtimes consistently via the ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/ -> ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/.dev-kit/hooks/ sed. The .codex/hooks.json file is the Codex-side mirror with DEV_KIT_AGENT=codex prefixes; install.sh rewrites it via the same sed loop.
